svg.title: Policy, explicit authority and atomic graph publication
svg.desc: A selected resolution is evaluated under a pinned policy. An immutable full-batch plan receives preflight and exact authorization receipts. The backend checks idempotency, repeats current-state and trust checks under its transaction lock, and commits graph state, records and journal together or rolls back.
